The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/myajvb/copyright.htm):
> The Holy Bible in the Burmese language of Myanmar, Judson version of 1840
> Public Domain
> Language: ဗမာ (Burmese)
> Translation by: Adoniram Judson
> 2025-10-20

What was found:
Text: Adoniram Judson's Burmese Bible (Judson died 1850), second edition 1840, Moulmein; a revision by John McGuire and others appeared in 1933.

Why it stays out: missing fact: eBible's text differs from the printed 1840 edition and carries partly modernized spelling and a modern Strong's-tagged digital source; the later edition and its editors are not identified.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=myajvb), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/myajvb/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adoniram_Judson.
